flavour: From the Realm of Chaos, the Daemonologist summons forth daemonic beasts to strike at their foes.
effect: The target enemy unit suffers 2D6 Strength 4 hits, each with an AP of -1.

flavour: Coal-black daemonic steeds materialise from the air, bearing warriors aloft on wings of shadow.
effect: This spell can only target friendly models whose troop type is ‘infantry’. If the target friendly unit is not fleeing and has not already moved during this Movement phase, it gains the Fly (12) special rule until your next Start of Turn sub-phase.

flavour: At the Daemonologist’s command, strange forms gather about the foe, their whispered taunts draining the enemy’s courage.
effect: Until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, the target enemy unit suffers a -2 modifier to its Initiative characteristic (to a minimum of 1), a -2 modifier to its Leadership characteristic (to a minimum of 2) and cannot use their General‘s Inspiring Presence special rule. This spell may target an enemy unit engaged in combat.

flavour: The Daemonologist’s many familiars fall upon the foe, slashing and biting with incorporeal claws and teeth.
effect: A single enemy unit the caster is engaged in combat with suffers 2D6 Strength 2 hits, with no armour save permitted (Ward and Regeneration saves can be attempted as normal).

flavour: At the Daemonologist’s bidding, otherworldly entities rush forth to take possession of their allies, filling their bodies with unnatural ferocity.
effect: Until the end of this turn, the caster, their mount and any unit they have joined, gain a +1 modifier to their Strength and Attacks characteristics (to a maximum of 10), and improve the Armour Piercing characteristic of their weapons by 1.

flavour: A swirling tear in reality opens, through which daemonic beasts grasp at those that venture too close.
effect: Remains in Play. Place a small (3”) blast template so that its central hole is within 15” of the caster. Whilst in play, the template is treated as difficult terrain. The template scatters D6” during every Start of Turn sub-phase (see page 95). Any unit (friend or foe) that moves through the template, or that the template moves over, suffers D6+1 Strength 3 hits, each with an AP of -.

flavour: As the Daemonologist mutters verses aloud from a proscribed text, their allies fill with a daemonic vitality.
effect: Until the end of this turn, the target friendly unit gains a +1 modifier to its Movement, Toughness and Initiative characteristics (to a maximum of 10).
